title.zh: 【PeckShield：Polymarket UI 可能被入侵，不要与网站交互】
title.en: 【PeckShield：Polymarket UI 可能被入侵，不要与网站交互】

current_state.zh: Polymarket 表示已修复供应链污染问题并恢复服务，承诺全额赔付受影响交易者；实际赔付进度仍待官方后续公告。
current_state.en: Polymarket says it has fixed the supply-chain compromise and restored service, and has promised full compensation to affected traders; actual compensation progress remains subject to official follow-up announcements.

updates.what_changed_zh: PeckShield 警告称 Polymarket 的用户界面可能已被入侵，并敦促用户停止与该网站交互。
updates.what_changed_en: PeckShield warned that Polymarket's user interface may have been compromised and urged users to stop interacting with the website.

updates.title_zh: GoPlus：Polymarket被盗因服务商DebugBear的RUM脚本遭供应链污染
updates.title_en: GoPlus：Polymarket被盗因服务商DebugBear的RUM脚本遭供应链污染
updates.what_changed_zh: GoPlus 将 Polymarket 国际站用户资产被盗（约 271 万美元，涉及 710 个 DepositWallet、731 个地址）归因于第三方性能监控服务商 DebugBear 的 RUM 脚本遭供应链污染；Polymarket 表示已修复问题、恢复服务，并承诺全额赔付受影响交易者。
updates.what_changed_en: GoPlus attributed the Polymarket international-site user asset theft (~$2.71M across 710 DepositWallets and 731 addresses) to a supply-chain compromise of third-party performance-monitoring vendor DebugBear's RUM script; Polymarket said it fixed the issue, restored service, and promised full compensation to affected traders.
updates.current_state_zh: Polymarket 表示已修复供应链污染问题并恢复服务，承诺全额赔付受影响交易者；实际赔付进度仍待官方后续公告。
updates.current_state_en: Polymarket says it has fixed the supply-chain compromise and restored service, and has promised full compensation to affected traders; actual compensation progress remains subject to official follow-up announcements.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: GoPlus traced the Polymarket international-site user asset theft (~$2.71M across 710 DepositWallets and 731 addresses) to a supply-chain compromise of third-party performance-monitoring vendor DebugBear's RUM script, which injected malicious code into user pages to abuse trading and signing permissions; Polymarket says it fixed the issue, restored service and promised full compensation to affected traders.
updates.detailed_summary_en: GoPlus traced the Polymarket international-site user asset theft (~$2.71M across 710 DepositWallets and 731 addresses) to a supply-chain compromise of third-party performance-monitoring vendor DebugBear's RUM script, which injected malicious code into user pages to abuse trading and signing permissions; Polymarket says it fixed the issue, restored service and promised full compensation to affected traders.
